definitions.contiguous_partition: Recursive balanced bisection of ascending node IDs until each leaf has at most 8 nodes.
definitions.cut_boundary: Unique vertices incident to an edge crossing a hierarchy cut.
definitions.graph_projection: Undirected simple projection of each synthetic input graph; self-loops excluded.
definitions.leaf_aperture: Unique vertices in a leaf frame incident to any edge joining a different leaf frame.
definitions.random_baseline: Same recursive balanced bisection after seeded node permutation; five fixed seeds per input.
definitions.treewidth: Exact brute-force minimum induced width when n<=10; deterministic min-fill upper bound at larger n.

limits: Synthetic structures only; node IDs encode the contiguous partition for the canonical arm.
No rule-semantic dependency analysis or partitioned execution is performed.
No natural task snapshot census or confirmatory sampling frame is established.
protocol: synthetic hierarchical structural census v1; benchmark protocol 1.1
